guitar.evidence: Josh Homme is well documented playing a Maton BB1200; Troy Van Leeuwen is associated with Fender Jazzmasters/Ovation. The original 'Ovation Ultra GP' is a less commonly cited detail.
guitar.notes: Streamlined model list to the most consistently documented instruments.

tone.target: dry fuzzed desert rock crunch with big riff bite
tone.profile: dry fuzzed desert rock crunch with big riff bite
tone.summary: Fuzz -> Boost (optional) -> Amp (UK 800 or Recti style) -> Cab (4x12) with minimal ambience for tight, aggressive riffing.

rig.name: Queens Of The Stone Age - Go With The Flow - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and noise inherent in high-gain fuzz tones.
Slight boost to push the fuzz stage and enhance riff attack.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD/DS for pure volume lift without color shift.

alternatives.reason: If more tonal shaping is needed.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core 'stout fuzz' and aggressive saturation required for desert rock.

alternatives.reason: If a more structured, less raw fuzz is desired.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a mid-forward, aggressive amp tone suitable for QOTSA's punchy riffing.
blocks.gap: The Recti model might be closer to modern metal, but UK 800 provides the necessary vintage grit and bite.

alternatives.reason: For a heavier, more scooped modern tone.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic, punchy 4x12 sound required for rock crunch.
Fine-tune the mid-bite and tighten up the low end without losing punch.
blocks.gap: Using EQ to sculpt the tone rather than relying on amp settings alone.

blocks.purpose: Add a minimal, dry ambience to give the riff space without sounding wet or distant.
blocks.gap: The requirement is 'dry/short ambience,' so Room is used sparingly (low mix) rather than Plate or Spring.

alternatives.reason: If a slightly more defined, less natural reverb tail is acceptable.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall tone punch by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive 4x12 model.

proposals.reason: Enhance the punch and aggression of the fuzz tone for better riff bite.
